Task-manager registered repo otohime with an enabled coding account and fleet/cluster execution on Node 22, locked npm install, real Chrome/Chromium, native embedded PostgreSQL17 or CI postgres17 service, git and network to npm/fonts. Existing operator-authorized fleet allocation, no paid runtime purchase; scheduler places jobs. Execution must also reach origin over SSH and construct the locked browser/database adapters; control-plane service probes do not establish this.

GitHub Actions for quiinthieu/otohime, CI workflow enabled on main push and workflow_dispatch, Ubuntu24.04 hosted runner with Chrome and postgres17 service. Workflow contents:read; production deployment uses existing repository secrets/variables. Public annotations/step summaries readable; authenticated raw historical logs optional because repository diagnostics provide a replacement. Existing repository owner's Actions allowance.
